subject: community-medicine
title: Health Promotion, Specific Protection and Early Diagnosis

steps.title: Health promotion strengthens the host
steps.tx: **Health promotion** enables people to increase control over their health and improve it, without targeting any single disease. It strengthens the host through health education, environmental modification, nutritional intervention and lifestyle change. Safe water, sanitary latrines, insect control and better housing therefore count as promotion, even though no doctor touches a patient.
steps.say: Promotion strengthens the host rather than attacking one disease. Education, cleaner surroundings, better nutrition and lifestyle change all qualify. Safe water and sanitary latrines count here too, even though no clinician touches a patient.

rows: Teaching precautions the public can act on
Safe water, latrines, vector control, housing

steps.title: Health education, the cheapest intervention
steps.tx: **Health education** ranks among the most cost effective interventions, since many diseases fall when people learn precautions in time. Targets include the general public, patients, priority groups, health providers, community leaders and decision makers. Each audience needs a different message and channel, which is why campaigns fail when one poster tries to speak to everyone.
steps.say: Teaching people early prevents more disease per rupee than most treatments. But audiences differ: public, patients, priority groups, providers, leaders and decision makers each need a fitted message. One poster for everyone is why campaigns fail.

steps.title: Specific protection aims at one hazard
steps.tx: **Specific protection** targets a named cause or hazard: immunisation, specific nutrients, chemoprophylaxis, protection against occupational hazards and accidents, protection from carcinogens, avoidance of allergens, and control of air pollution, noise and unsafe consumer products. Unlike promotion, each measure names its enemy, so coverage can be counted person by person and hazard by hazard.
steps.say: Protection names its enemy. Vaccines, specific nutrients, chemoprophylaxis, guards against workplace hazards and allergen avoidance all qualify. Because each measure targets one hazard, coverage can be counted person by person, unlike broad promotion.

steps.title: Vaccine platforms as specific protection
steps.tx: The panels classify **vaccines** into live attenuated, inactivated, subunit, polysaccharide conjugate, viral vector and messenger RNA platforms, each with Indian examples. Platform decides cold chain needs, booster logic and use in pregnancy or immune suppression. Live vaccines such as BCG and oral polio vaccine multiply in the host, while killed and subunit products cannot.
steps.say: Look at the six panels. Live attenuated, inactivated, subunit, conjugate, viral vector and messenger RNA products each carry Indian examples. Platform decides storage, boosters and safety in pregnancy. Live products multiply in the host; killed and subunit products cannot.

vis.alt: Six panels showing live attenuated, inactivated, subunit, polysaccharide conjugate, viral vector and mRNA vaccine platforms with Indian example vaccines.
vis.caption: Six vaccine platforms with Indian examples: live, killed, subunit, conjugate, vector and mRNA. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.title: BCG technique shows protection in practice
steps.tx: **BCG vaccination** shows specific protection at the point of delivery: a live attenuated vaccine given intradermally over the left deltoid, raising a wheal that ulcerates and heals into a permanent depressed scar over weeks. Absence of a scar prompts review of technique and cold chain. The same visit also checks which other antigens fall due.
steps.say: Watch protection being delivered. This live vaccine goes intradermally over the left deltoid. A wheal forms, ulcerates, then heals into a small depressed scar. No scar means technique or cold chain needs review, and the visit doubles as a check for other due vaccines.

vis.alt: Intradermal BCG injection over the deltoid with the healing sequence from wheal through ulcer to permanent depressed scar.
vis.caption: Intradermal BCG technique and scar healing from wheal to depressed scar. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.title: Promotion versus protection in one table
steps.tx: Separate the pair cleanly for exams: **health promotion** raises general resistance without a named target, while specific protection blocks a named cause. Nutrition education is promotion; vitamin A mega doses are protection. Physical activity campaigns are promotion; helmets are protection. Stems that name a disease or hazard almost always want protection as the answer.
steps.say: Keep the pair apart. Promotion raises general resistance with no named target. Protection blocks one named cause. Nutrition teaching is promotion, vitamin A doses are protection. When a stem names a disease or hazard, protection is usually the answer.

steps.title: Early diagnosis before symptoms declare
steps.tx: **Early diagnosis** detects disturbed homeostasis while biochemical, morphological and functional changes remain reversible, before manifest signs appear. That timing matters most in chronic disease, where late presentation forfeits reversibility. Treating tuberculosis, leprosy and sexually transmitted infections early also shortens communicability, so one intervention serves the patient and the community together.
steps.say: Diagnosis counts as early when change is still reversible, before signs declare themselves. Chronic disease rewards that timing most. Treating tuberculosis, leprosy and sexually transmitted infections early also shortens spread, serving patient and community together.

steps.title: Spark versus fire brigade
steps.tx: Teachers compare **early treatment** to stamping out a spark rather than calling the fire brigade for a blaze. Hypertension, cervical cancer and breast cancer all repay early therapy with lower mortality. Mass treatment extends the logic where latent infections outnumber clinical cases four or five to one, as historically in yaws, trachoma and filariasis control.
steps.say: Stamp out the spark instead of fighting the blaze. Hypertension and cervical or breast cancer repay early therapy with fewer deaths. Where hidden infections outnumber visible cases several fold, mass treatment extends the same logic across a community.

steps.title: Health protection is the wider cousin
steps.tx: Examiners separate **health protection** from specific protection: protection of health means conditions for normal mental and physical functioning, spanning promotion, prevention, cure and restoration inside overall community development. Literacy campaigns, education and food production therefore belong to the wider term. When a stem lists broad development actions, choose the wider label, not the narrow one.
steps.say: One wider term causes confusion. Conditions for normal functioning, spanning promotion, prevention, cure and restoration within community development, carry the broader label. Literacy and food production belong there. Broad development in a stem points to the wider answer.

rows: General host strength, no named target
Promotion, prevention, cure and restoration in development
